items.title: Amgen Reports Phase 3 Dazodalibep Trial Meets Primary Endpoint in Sjögren’s Disease
items.summary: Amgen (NASDAQ:AMGN) announced that its investigational treatment dazodalibep met the primary endpoint in the Phase 3 OASIZ-301 clinical trial, demonstrating statistically significant reductions in systemic disease activity among patients with Sjögren’s disease compared with placebo. The 648-patient study evaluated two dosing regimens over 48 weeks, with both achieving the primary endpoint measured by the European Alliance of Associations for Rheumatology Sjögren’s Syndrome Disease Activity Index
